decisions.title: Tee shot
decisions.setup: The fairway bends right up ahead, with a bunker sitting on the corner and trees behind it. Where should we hit this one?
decisions.wren: The bend's the fun part — now let's see what's waiting around the corner.

opts.label: 3-wood, at the corner
opts.sub: left-center of fairway, taking the bunker out of play · 122

zones.text: fairway bunker — the right tail of the fan still reaches the bunker's 120–145y window at this distance (K3: the 3-wood's nominal carry sits inside that window, so the honest table shows one bunker ball, not zero). Not risk-free — just the lowest-risk option.

card.what: Your shorter, safer shot found the fairway — seven of ten do. That bunker still nabs the odd ball, even from here.
card.others: Driver aimed away from the bunker found the fairway six of ten. Cutting the corner found the bunker on the RIGHT more often than not.

opts.label: Driver, left-center of fairway
opts.sub: aimed away from the right-side bunker · 135

zones.text: the driver's wide fan still tags the right-side bunker despite the safer aim — driver dispersion is real even when you aim it right. Leaves ~85y approach on the fairway outcomes.

card.what: Your drive found the fairway, aimed away from the bunker on the right — six of ten do from here.
card.others: The safer shot found the fairway seven of ten, the bunker once. The corner cut found sand or trees more often than not.

opts.label: Driver, cut the corner

zones.text: successful cut (carries past the corner, ~52y remaining — a sand wedge in, not "65y," per J10's fix on the arithmetic).

card.what: Your ball found the fairway bunker — five of ten do from here. Clear the corner and it's just a wedge in — that's the prize.
card.others: Driver aimed away from the bunker found the fairway six of ten. The shorter, safer shot found it even more often.

decisions.title: Approach
decisions.setup: Middle of the fairway, a full swing from the green. The flag's tucked back-left, right behind that front bunker. Where should we aim?
decisions.wren: Tucked flags are sneaky — the whole green's still in play, though.

opts.label: 7-iron, wide side of the green

zones.text: right fringe/rough (harmless — this is what "safe" actually buys you: a better miss, not a higher hit rate)
short right. No hazard on this line — a real safe play, not a decoy (J5's fix; numbers corrected per K2 — offsetting the aim point off a 20-yd-wide green can't out-find Standard's center aim).

card.what: Your ball landed on the wide side of the green — five of ten do — and nothing on that line can hurt you.
card.others: Aiming at the middle found the green six of ten. Firing at the tucked flag found the front-left bunker more often than not.

opts.label: 7-iron, center of the green
opts.sub: ignore the tucked pin, aim middle · 85

zones.text: short of the green (short-skew, F2.1 — this is what actually teaches P5)
long. The best green-finding option, correctly, since it's aimed at the green's center.

card.what: Your ball landed on the green, comfortably away from the tucked pin — six of ten do from here.
card.others: The wide side found the green five of ten, never the bunker. Firing at the tucked flag found sand more often than not.

opts.label: 7-iron, at the flag
opts.sub: attack the tucked back-left pin, directly over the front-left bunker · ~93 to the flag

zones.text: front-left bunker (under-clubbed at the tucked pin, and short-skewed misses on that line find the bunker guarding it)

card.what: Your ball found the front-left bunker — six of ten do, since that flag hides right behind it. Land it and you're right beside the flag.
card.others: Aiming at the middle found the green six of ten. The wide side found it a bit less often, and never the bunker.

decisions.title: Around the green (putting)
decisions.setup: On the green, twenty feet away. The slope runs right-to-left — about a yard of break. How should we roll it?
decisions.wren: Big breaking putt — reading it is half the fun.

opts.label: Aim a yard and a bit RIGHT, lag it soft

zones.text: inside 3 feet (0 holed — this read isn't trying to make it, just get it close safely)
outside 6 ft. (Corrected per K5: the stroke is firm, not decelerating, so it has to reach the hole sometimes — a 10/10-short table was the "die it" fault in numbers even after the words changed.)

card.what: Your lag finished in tap-in range — five of ten do with the full-break read. Nice and cozy.
card.others: Playing the break at hole-high pace got inside three feet just as often, and made one. Taking the break out ran well past.

opts.label: Aim a yard RIGHT, hole-high pace

card.what: Your putt finished in tap-in range, hole-high — half of them do from here. Sometimes one even drops.
card.others: The full-break lag got inside three feet just as often, none dropping. Taking the break out ran well past the hole.

opts.label: Straight at it, firm

zones.text: finish 4–8 ft past (fighting the read means missing the line more, not just the speed)

card.what: Your putt ran well past the hole — five of ten do when you take the break out. Brave stroke; the slope had other ideas.
card.others: Playing the break at hole-high pace finished inside three feet half the time. The full-break lag did the same, a touch softer.

decisions.title: Tee shot
decisions.setup: Short hole, one swing to the green. A bunker guards the front-right, the flag's tucked behind it, and it's open past the back. Where should we hit it?
decisions.wren: Nothing waiting behind this green — I love a hole that lets you swing free.

opts.label: Fat, front-middle of the green, away from the pin

card.what: Your ball landed on the fat middle of the green — five of ten do. Almost as many come up short in the first cut.
card.others: Flying it at the flag found the green six of ten. Cutting it tight over the bunker found the green less, the sand more.

opts.label: Right at the flag, enough club to finish pin-high

card.what: Your ball flew right at the flag and landed on the green — six of ten do with enough club.
card.others: The fat middle found the green five of ten, the rest mostly short in the first cut. Cutting it tight found sand more often.

opts.label: Tight over the bunker, cutting it close to the tucked pin

card.what: Your ball landed on the green, tight to the tucked flag — four of ten do. The bunker catches nearly as many.
card.others: Flying at the flag with more room found the green six of ten. The fat middle found it slightly less, never the sand.

decisions.title: Recovery
decisions.setup: Most of yours are on the green — lovely. One found the sand. Let's play that one too; everybody needs to know the beach.
decisions.wren: Sand happens to everybody. Even the pros get to play from the beach.

opts.label: Splash out to the fat, safe middle of the green

card.what: Your splash landed on the fat middle of the green — five of ten get out and on from here.
card.others: Splashing toward the flag reached the green four of ten, a closer look. Flirting with the lip stayed in the sand more than anywhere.

opts.label: Splash out toward the flag, short of the tucked pin

card.what: Your splash landed on the green, closer to the flag — four of ten do. The rest stay in sand or fly long.
card.others: Splashing to the fat middle got out and on five of ten. Flirting with the lip stayed in the sand more than anywhere.

opts.label: Spin it tight, flirting with the lip at the tucked pin

card.what: Your ball stayed in the sand — four of ten do when you flirt with that lip. The lip usually wins.
card.others: Splashing to the fat middle got out and on five of ten. Splashing toward the flag got out a little less, with a closer look.

decisions.title: Around the green (putting)
decisions.setup: Twenty feet, almost dead straight — barely a cup of break. How hard should we hit it?
decisions.wren: Nearly straight putt — it's all about the speed today.

opts.label: Smooth, unhurried roll from the cup's LEFT edge — uses the whole cup of break

card.what: Your unhurried roll finished in tap-in range — five of ten do. Come up light and it stops just outside the circle.
card.others: Hole-high pace finished in tap-in range six of ten, and sometimes dropped. Back-of-the-cup pace ran well past the hole.

opts.label: Firm enough to finish level with the hole, just inside the LEFT edge — takes half the break

card.what: Your putt rolled at hole-high pace into tap-in range — six of ten do from here. Now and then it drops.
card.others: The unhurried roll finished in tap-in range five of ten. Back-of-the-cup pace ran well past the hole as often as not.

opts.label: Struck at the back of the cup, hard enough to take the break out

card.what: Your putt ran well past the hole — five of ten do at back-of-the-cup pace. The cup's smaller than it looks!
card.others: Hole-high pace finished in tap-in range six of ten, and sometimes dropped. The unhurried roll got there a little less often.

decisions.title: Tee shot
decisions.setup: Long hole. Trees crowd the right side where the fairway bends, and the left is wide open. What's the plan off the tee?
decisions.wren: Trees on the right, room on the left — this hole shows its hand early.

opts.label: 3-wood down the LEFT side, away from the first bend's trouble

card.what: Your shorter, safer shot found the fairway down the left — eight of ten do — a little behind where a driver lands.
card.others: Driver down the left-center found the fairway six of ten, a bit further on. Hugging the trees found the fairway less, the trees more.

opts.label: Driver, left-center line, away from the trees

card.what: Your drive found the fairway down the left-center, away from the trees — six of ten do from here.
card.others: The shorter, safer shot found the fairway eight of ten, a little further back. Cutting it close to the trees found them more often.

opts.label: Driver, cutting the line closer to the trees for extra position

card.what: Your ball found the fairway, hugging the RIGHT side — five of ten do. The trees grab a couple from that line.
card.others: Driver aimed left-center found the fairway six of ten, clear of the trees. The shorter shot found it even more, a little further back.

decisions.title: Layup vs. go for it in two
decisions.setup: Water cuts across the corner between you and the green, still a long way off. What's the next shot?
decisions.wren: Water on the corner, green just beyond — the big decision. Fun, isn't it?

opts.label: 7-iron, short layup well clear of the water

zones.text: rough (harmless) — leaves a longer, in-between number in

card.what: Your short layup found the fairway — eight of ten do. From there it's an in-between number into the green.
card.others: The best-number layup found the fairway seven of ten, leaving a full swing in. Going for it found water as often as not.

opts.label: 5-iron, layup to the 296-yd marker — your best number

zones.text: rough (harmless) — leaves a full 9-iron (84 yd nominal) in

card.what: Your layup found the fairway at your best number — seven of ten do — leaving a full, comfortable swing into the green.
card.others: The short layup found grass even more often, leaving an awkward in-between number. Going for it over the water found the drink five of ten.

opts.label: Driver off the deck, trying to carry the water and reach the green in two

zones.text: clears the water and finds the green or fringe
caught in the trouble along the corner (RIGHT)
bails out short-right into the layup area

card.what: Your ball found the water — as often as not, going for it. Clear it and you're on the green in two — the big prize.
card.others: The best-number layup found the fairway seven of ten, leaving a full swing in. The short layup found grass even more often.

decisions.title: Around the green (putting)
decisions.setup: Twenty-four feet, sliding left-to-right — a couple of feet of break. How should we play it?
decisions.wren: Long putt, sneaky slope — the slide's the fun part to read.

opts.label: Aim two feet and a bit LEFT, lag it soft

zones.text: outside three feet on the low side

card.what: Your softer lag finished in tap-in range — five of ten do. The slope drags a few below the hole.
card.others: Committed pace on that line got in tap-in range six of ten, sometimes dropping. Taking the break out missed low as often as not.

opts.label: Aim two feet LEFT, hole-high pace

zones.text: inside three feet (1 of those holed)

card.what: Your putt held its line at a committed pace and finished in tap-in range — six of ten do. Now and then it drops.
card.others: The softer lag finished in tap-in range five of ten, some sliding low. Taking the break out missed low as often as not.

opts.label: Straight at it, firm

zones.text: inside three feet (1 of those holed)

card.what: Your putt slid below the hole, outside the circle — five of ten do when you take the break out. The slope gets a vote.
card.others: Playing the break at a committed pace finished in tap-in range six of ten, sometimes dropping. The softer lag got there a little less often.

decisions.title: Tee shot
decisions.setup: Bunkers pinch the fairway on both sides, left and right, right where a big drive lands. What should we hit off the tee?
decisions.wren: Bunkers left and right — a hole that makes you pick before you swing.

opts.label: 5-iron, laid back well short of the pinch

zones.text: rough — leaves a full 5-iron in (110 yd)

card.what: Your layup stopped safely short of the pinch and found the fairway — eight of ten do — a full iron in from here.
card.others: Driver threading the gap found the fairway five of ten, the rest mostly in bunkers. Swinging all-out found the fairway a little less.

opts.label: Driver, threading the 22-yard gap between the bunkers

zones.text: short rough — leaves a 7-iron in (80 yd)

card.what: Your drive threaded the gap between the bunkers and found the fairway — five of ten do, leaving a shorter iron in.
card.others: Laying back short of the pinch found the fairway eight of ten, a full iron in. Swinging all-out found the fairway a little less.

opts.label: Driver, swinging all-out to fly it past the pinch entirely

card.what: Your all-out swing found the fairway — four of ten do. The bunkers left and right collect most of the rest.
card.others: A normal driver swing threaded the gap five of ten. Laying back short of the pinch found fairway far more, a full iron in.

decisions.title: Approach
decisions.setup: A full iron from the green. Flag in the middle, one bunker tucked front-right. Where should we aim?
decisions.wren: That bunker's tucked front-right. The rest of the green is all yours.

opts.label: 5-iron, well LEFT of the pin

card.what: Your ball stopped on the LEFT fringe, well clear of the sand — four of ten do. A few drift into the LEFT rough.
card.others: A shade left of centre found the green four of ten, misses on the collar. Dead at the pin found the bunker more than anywhere.

opts.label: 5-iron, a shade LEFT of centre, away from the bunker

zones.text: short on the collar LEFT of centre

card.what: Your shot, aimed a shade left of centre, found the green — four of ten do. The short ones sit on the collar.
card.others: Bailing well LEFT found the fringe most often, the green now and then. Aiming dead at the pin found the bunker four of ten.

opts.label: 5-iron, dead at the pin

card.what: Your ball found the FRONT-RIGHT bunker — four of ten do dead at the pin. Land it and you're right beside the flag.
card.others: A shade left of centre found the green four of ten, misses on the collar. Bailing well LEFT never saw sand, fringe mostly.

decisions.title: Around the green (chip)
decisions.setup: Most are on. Two stopped just short on the collar — let's play one of those, it's a fun little shot.
decisions.wren: Nothing guarding that flag — a chip you can play lots of ways.

opts.label: 7-iron, land in the fringe, run to the middle, short of the flag

card.what: Your 7-iron runner rolled up to the middle and stopped short of the flag — half of them do. A longer putt, safe ground.
card.others: The 9-iron released straight at the flag and stopped inside ten feet as often as not. The high sand wedge stopped fast, a longer putt.

opts.label: Sand wedge, high and soft, to the middle
opts.sub: carries most of it, stops fast

card.what: Your sand wedge flew high, landed soft and stopped in the middle — four of ten do. A longer putt, but all green.
card.others: The 9-iron released straight at the flag and stopped inside ten feet as often as not. The low runner stopped short of the flag.

opts.label: 9-iron, land on the front edge, release straight at the flag

card.what: Your 9-iron ran straight at the flag and stopped inside ten feet — as often as not from here. A short putt left.
card.others: The 7-iron runner stopped in the middle, short of the flag. The high sand wedge stopped fast, leaving a longer putt.

decisions.title: Tee shot
decisions.setup: Water covers everything between you and the green — no way round, only over. Which shot do you want?
decisions.wren: Water in front, green behind — everybody remembers their first splash hole.

opts.label: Fat, back-middle of the green — plenty of club to clear the water

zones.text: short of the green (past the water)

card.what: Your ball flew over the water and landed on the back of the green — five of ten do. Nearly as many sail over the back.
card.others: Enough club with real margin found the green six of ten, never the water. Less club at the flag mostly came up short, some wet.

opts.label: Right at the flag, enough club to clear the water with real margin

zones.text: short of the green (past the water)

card.what: Your ball cleared the water with room to spare and landed on the green — six of ten do with enough club.
card.others: Lots of extra club found the green five of ten, often sailing long. Less club at the flag mostly came up short, some wet.

opts.label: A touchy, exact number tight at the flag — taking a little less club to keep it close

card.others: Enough club with margin found the green six of ten, never the water. Lots of extra club found it too, sailing long nearly as often.

decisions.title: Recovery
decisions.setup: Most of yours are on the green — lovely. One found the sand. Let's play that one too; everybody needs to know the beach.
decisions.wren: Bunker sand, big green — it's just one more swing.

opts.label: Splash out to the fat, safe middle of the green

card.what: Your ball stayed in the bunker — four of ten do trying to spin it at the flag. Spin from sand is a tour trick.
card.others: Splashing toward the flag got out and on five of ten, close. The fat-middle splash got out just as often, a longer putt.

card.others: Rolling it level with the hole finished in tap-in range six of ten, sometimes dropping. The hard putt ran well past more often than not.

opts.label: Firm enough to finish level with the hole, just inside the RIGHT edge

card.what: Your putt rolled up to finish level with the hole, in tap-in range — six of ten do. Now and then it drops.
card.others: The cosy roll finished in tap-in range nearly as often, some stopping short of the circle. The hard putt ran well past six of ten.

opts.label: Hard enough to take the cup out of it, straight at the back edge

zones.text: outside three feet on the low side

card.what: Your putt raced past the hole — six of ten do at that speed — leaving a real second putt. Great line, plenty of gas!
card.others: Rolling it level with the hole finished in tap-in range six of ten, sometimes dropping. The cosy roll got there nearly as often.

decisions.title: Tee shot
decisions.setup: Two bends ahead, trees tucked inside each one. Where should we hit it off the tee?
decisions.wren: Two bends, trees on the inside of each — this hole has a wiggle to it.

opts.label: 5-iron, into the wide straight section short of the first bend
opts.sub: Center, staying well left of the right-corner trees · 130

zones.text: right rough (edge of the tree zone) — leaves 115, a full 7-iron

card.what: Your layup stopped in the wide, straight bit short of the first bend — seven of ten find the fairway — and never saw a tree.
card.others: Driver round the first bend found the fairway five of ten, some in the RIGHT trees. Cutting both corners found trees as often as not.

opts.label: Driver, at the natural first-bend landing area
opts.sub: Left-center, playing the bend as it's drawn · 155

zones.text: in the right-corner trees — leaves 90, a 9-iron

card.what: Your drive followed the first bend and found the fairway — five of ten do — playing the hole the way it's drawn.
card.others: The layup short of the bend found the fairway seven of ten, never a tree. Cutting both corners found the trees as often as not.

opts.label: Driver, at the direct cut-both-corners line
opts.sub: Threading the 18–20-yard gap between both tree lines · 178 (carry needed)

zones.text: clear both corners and reach the fairway

card.what: Your ball flew at both corners at once and finished in the trees — five of ten do. Thread it and you've beaten the whole bend.
card.others: The layup short of the bend found the fairway seven of ten, never a tree. Driver round the bend found it as often as not.

decisions.title: Approach
decisions.setup: Short of the first bend, a full iron from the green. Flag tucked back-left with a bunker right beside it. Where should we aim?
decisions.wren: Flag tucked back-left, bunker cuddled up beside it — the green's got a big open middle though.

opts.label: 7-iron
opts.sub: RIGHT-centre of the green, away from the bunker · 110

card.what: Your ball landed on the RIGHT-centre of the green, well away from the bunker — five of ten do — a longer putt from there.
card.others: The same club at the dead centre found the green six of ten. Going at the tucked BACK-LEFT flag found sand as often as not.

opts.label: 7-iron

card.what: Your ball, aimed at the dead centre of the green, found it — six of ten do. The tucked flag can wait.
card.others: Aiming RIGHT-centre, away from the bunker, found the green five of ten, longer putts. Going at the tucked flag found sand as often as not.

opts.label: 7-iron
opts.sub: At the tucked BACK-LEFT pin, next to the bunker · 110 (needs 121)

zones.text: short-LEFT rough — the flag plays 121, the club is 11 short, so the miss is short-LEFT, into the sand

card.what: Your ball came up short-LEFT and found the bunker — five of ten do. That flag plays longer than it looks, right beside the sand.
card.others: The same club at the dead centre found the green six of ten. Aiming RIGHT-centre, away from the bunker, found it less, longer putts.

decisions.title: Around the green (putting)
decisions.setup: Twenty-two feet, uphill and across a right-to-left slope. How much break should we play?
decisions.wren: Uphill and across the slope — a putt that changes its mind about how much it breaks.

opts.label: Play the full four feet you would play on a flat green — start it well RIGHT, high side, with pace to get up the hill

zones.text: finish on the high side (RIGHT), outside three feet
short of the circle — the hill eats pace

card.what: Your full-break putt finished in tap-in range — four of ten do. The hill eats pace, so a few stop short or hang high RIGHT.
card.others: Playing less break, with pace to reach, got in tap-in range six of ten. Straight at it slid low LEFT more often than not.

opts.label: Play about half of that — uphill putts break less — with pace to reach the hole

card.what: Your putt played less break than the flat read, up the hill to tap-in range — six of ten do. Now and then it drops.
card.others: The full flat-green read hung high RIGHT a few times, or ran out of legs. Straight at it slid low LEFT five of ten.

opts.label: Straight at the hole, hit hard enough to hold the line up the slope

card.what: Your putt slid below the hole, LEFT, outside the circle — five of ten do straight at it. Uphill or not, the slope's still there!
card.others: Playing less break, with pace to reach, got in tap-in range six of ten. The full flat read hung high RIGHT or stopped short.

decisions.title: Tee shot
decisions.setup: A stream crosses the fairway way up ahead — far out of reach from here. What should we hit off the tee?
decisions.wren: A stream cutting right across the fairway up ahead — but from the tee it's just wide-open grass.

opts.label: 5-iron

card.what: Your iron found the fairway — eight of ten do — a long, long way from the green, the stream far off in the distance.
card.others: Driver found the fairway six of ten, a lot further on. The smaller wood landed in between, finding it a little more often.

opts.label: 3-wood

card.what: Your wood found the fairway — seven of ten do — a good way down, the stream still well out of reach.
card.others: Driver found the fairway six of ten, further on. The iron found it nearly every time, a long way back.

opts.label: Driver, full committed swing at your normal tempo

card.what: Your full, committed drive found the fairway — six of ten do — with nothing out here in reach of a miss. Stream's miles away.
card.others: The 3-wood found the fairway a little more often, further back. The 5-iron found it nearly every time, a long way back.

decisions.title: Layup
decisions.setup: The stream is about fifty yards ahead now, and the green sits well beyond it. Lay up short, or try the carry?
decisions.wren: The stream's right there across the fairway — the whole hole's been waiting for this shot.

opts.label: Sand wedge, well short of the water

card.what: Your sand wedge stopped well short of the stream — eight of ten find the fairway — with a longer third shot still to come.
card.others: Pressing to the safe limit found the fairway seven of ten, wet once. Going for the carry cleared it as often as not.

opts.label: 9-iron, pressed toward the safe limit

zones.text: finds the water on a long miss

card.what: Your layup stopped right at the edge of the safe zone — seven of ten do — leaving a full club into the green.
card.others: The sand wedge stayed short of the stream eight of ten, longer in. Going for the carry cleared it as often as not, some wet.

opts.label: 5-iron, attempting to carry the water

zones.text: comes up well short (safe but wasted)

card.what: Your ball carried the stream with room to spare — five of ten do going for it. A couple splash, a couple just scrape over.
card.others: Pressing to the safe limit found the fairway seven of ten, a full club in. The sand wedge stayed short of the stream more often.

decisions.title: Around the green (putting)
decisions.setup: Thirty feet — the longest putt of the nine — across a gentle slope. How do we get it close?
decisions.wren: Thirty feet, the longest putt on the whole course — a proper lag across a big green.

opts.label: Play the full break and lag it into the circle — a long, smooth stroke with no thought of making it

zones.text: outside three feet on the low side (RIGHT)

card.what: Your gentle lag finished in tap-in range — five of ten do from way out here. A few run out of legs short of the circle.
card.others: The same read at hole-high pace got in tap-in range six of ten, sometimes dropping. Running at the hole slid low RIGHT more often.

opts.label: Play the full break, with pace to finish hole-high

card.what: From way out here, your full-break putt at hole-high pace finished in tap-in range — six of ten do. Every so often it drops.
card.others: The gentle lag got in tap-in range nearly as often, a few short. Running at the hole slid low RIGHT five of ten.

opts.label: Take some break out and give it a real run at the hole

card.what: Your putt slid below the hole, RIGHT, outside the circle — five of ten do with break taken out. A long way to chase a hole!
card.others: The full-break read at hole-high pace got in tap-in range six of ten, sometimes dropping. The gentle lag got there nearly as often.

decisions.title: Tee shot
decisions.setup: Wide open, nothing to hit, the most forgiving hole of the eighteen. How big a swing do you fancy?
decisions.wren: The widest fairway on the whole course, nothing to hit for ages — the friendliest tee box there is.

opts.label: The short, easy one, to the wide middle of the fairway — well short of everything

card.what: Your short, easy shot found the wide middle of the fairway — eight of ten do — with a long way still to go to the green.
card.others: The big, free swing found the fairway six of ten, a lot further on. The medium shot landed in between, a little more often.

opts.label: The medium one, a full swing at the fat middle of the fairway

card.what: Your medium shot found the fat middle of the fairway — seven of ten do — a good way down, a shortish shot in.
card.others: The big, free swing found the fairway six of ten, further on still. The short, easy shot found it nearly every time, well back.

opts.label: The big one — a full, free, committed swing down the middle at your normal tempo

zones.text: RIGHT rough — leaves 45 in, the shortest shot of the three

card.what: Your big, free swing down the middle found the fairway — six of ten do — and nothing out here is in reach of a miss.
card.others: The short, easy shot found the fairway eight of ten, leaving the longest shot in. The medium shot found it a bit more often.

decisions.title: Approach
decisions.setup: A short shot in, flag tucked back-right beside a little bunker. Where should we land it?
decisions.wren: A flat green, one tiny bunker off to the side — about as calm as an approach gets.

opts.label: The LEFT half of the green, as far from the bunker as the green allows

zones.text: on the green, LEFT half (long putt across)

card.what: Your ball landed on the LEFT side of the green, well away from the bunker — five of ten do. A long putt across.
card.others: A full swing at the centre found the green six of ten, misses on the apron. Going straight at the flag found the sand once.

opts.label: The centre of the green, a full committed swing

card.what: Your full swing at the centre of the green found it — six of ten do — and the misses stop just short on the apron.
card.others: Playing to the LEFT side found the green five of ten, all far from the flag. Going straight at the flag found the sand once.

opts.label: Straight at the BACK-RIGHT flag — a full committed swing

zones.text: on the green, RIGHT side near the flag

card.what: Your ball landed on the RIGHT side of the green, near the flag — five of ten do. That little bunker nabs the occasional stray.
card.others: A full swing at the centre found the green six of ten, misses on the apron. The LEFT side found it less, long putts.

decisions.title: Around the green (putting)
decisions.setup: Twenty feet, dead straight, nothing to read at all. It's all about the speed — how firm?
decisions.wren: Dead flat, dead straight — the simplest putt on the whole course, just you and the speed.

opts.label: A gentle roll, just enough to reach the front of the cup

card.what: Your gentle roll finished in tap-in range — five of ten do. A few run out of steam just short of the circle.
card.others: Rolling it level with the hole finished in tap-in range six of ten. Going for it got close nearly as often, a few running past.

opts.label: Rolled to finish level with the hole, straight at it

card.what: Your putt rolled dead straight and stopped level with the hole, in tap-in range — six of ten do. Sometimes it even drops.
card.others: The gentle roll got close nearly as often, a few stopping short. Going for it got close nearly as often, a few running past.

opts.label: Straight at it, pace to finish a foot past — trying to make it

card.what: You went for it and finished in tap-in range — five of ten do. The rest ran a bit by.
card.others: Rolling it level with the hole finished in tap-in range six of ten, sometimes dropping. The gentle roll got there nearly as often.

decisions.title: Tee shot
decisions.setup: Water hugs the whole right side off this tee and the fairway bends left. Where do we aim?
decisions.wren: Last tee of the nine — water down the right, a bend to the left, a proper finishing hole.

opts.label: 3-wood, extra buffer from the water
opts.sub: Left, giving the water plenty of room · 140

card.what: Your 3-wood, aimed well LEFT of the water, found the fairway as often as not. Nearly as many find the LEFT rough; trees nab one.
card.others: Driver aimed LEFT-centre found the fairway six of ten, wet once. Driver hugging the RIGHT edge found the water more than the fairway.

opts.label: Driver, left-center of the fairway

card.what: Your drive, aimed LEFT-centre away from the water, found the fairway — six of ten do — with the water nowhere in the picture.
card.others: The 3-wood aimed further LEFT found the fairway less, more rough, a tree once. Hugging the RIGHT edge got wet as often as not.

opts.label: Driver, hugging the right edge for a better angle in
opts.sub: Right edge, along the water line · 160

card.what: Your ball drifted RIGHT and found the water — five of ten do hugging that edge. Splash! The pros have wet ones too.
card.others: Driver aimed LEFT-centre found the fairway six of ten, well clear of the water. Aiming further LEFT found it a bit less, more rough.

decisions.title: Approach
decisions.setup: Flag tucked back-right with water short of it. How much club do we take?
decisions.wren: Flag tucked back-right with the water leaning in — the last green likes to put on a show.

opts.label: 7-iron, eased back short of center

card.what: Your eased-off swing landed on the front of the green — five of ten do. A few stop just short on the apron.
card.others: The full, committed swing found the centre of the green six of ten. Pressing for the tucked pin found the water more than the green.

opts.label: 7-iron, full committed swing

card.what: Your full, committed swing found the centre of the green — six of ten do — well clear of the water beside the flag.
card.others: Easing off found the green five of ten, the front bit. Pressing for the tucked pin found the water more than the green.

opts.label: 7-iron, pressed for extra distance

card.what: Your pressed swing drifted short-RIGHT and found the water beside the flag — five of ten do. That pin sits right on the edge!
card.others: The full, committed swing found the centre of the green six of ten. Easing off found the green a bit less, the front bit.

decisions.title: Around the green (putting)
decisions.setup: Last green of the nine: downhill and sliding right-to-left. How much break do we give it?
decisions.wren: Last green of the nine, downhill and sliding — however it finishes, you played this like a golfer.

opts.label: Give it even more than the downhill read — start it a foot above the full line and let gravity do the work

zones.text: finish on the high side (LEFT), outside three feet

card.what: Your extra-break putt finished in tap-in range — five of ten do. Gravity does most of the work; a few hang up high LEFT.
card.others: The full downhill read at just-enough pace got in tap-in range six of ten. The flat read hit firm ran well past low RIGHT.

opts.label: Play the full downhill break — more than it looks — with just enough pace to finish hole-high

card.what: Your putt took the full downhill break at just-enough pace and finished in tap-in range — six of ten do. Sometimes it drops.
card.others: The extra-break line hung high LEFT a few times. The flat-green read, hit firm, ran well past on the low side six of ten.

opts.label: Play the flat-green read and hit it firm at the hole

zones.text: run 6–10 feet past on the low side (RIGHT)

card.what: Your putt ran well past on the low side, RIGHT — six of ten do hitting the flat read firm. Downhill, the ball just keeps going!
card.others: The full downhill read at just-enough pace got in tap-in range six of ten, sometimes dropping. The extra-break line hung high LEFT a few times.
